item.title: Santa Clara County tackles $470M budget shortfall
item.description: Santa Clara County leaders are looking at a $470 million deficit in the upcoming fiscal year — forcing the largest midyear budget adjustment in more than a decade as they look to close $200 million of the gap. item.description: Downtown Palo Alto will soon get an infusion of color and whimsy thanks to a new city program to commission murals for prominent buildings in the area. item.title: Stanford vandalism case ends in mistrial after ‘hopelessly deadlocked’ jury
